comparisons.peer_topic: Losses on loans written down to collateral value
comparisons.peer_summary: The nonrecurring fair value adjustments include losses on loans written down to a collateral value of zero, amounting to $8 million, $10 million, and $15 million during 2024, 2023, and 2022, respectively.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures report specific credit loss amounts related to acquired or restructured assets, but they measure different economic events. Cdiscloses the par value of purchased credit-deteriorated assets upon acquisition ($52 million), reflecting the gross exposure taken on when buying distressed loans. In contrast, BAC reports losses on loans written down to collateral value ($8 million), reflecting the specific impairment expense recognized in the period for existing or acquired loans that failed to meet collateral coverage. C's figure represents acquisition volume of impaired assets, while BAC's represents realized loss recognition from collateral shortfall.
